sonnet.problem: This choice card asks about Matthew 22:26 (what happened to the second brother) before any story card has told verse 26. Story card 7 tells it afterward. The question jumps ahead, and the baker has no setup to reason from.
sonnet.rule: Cards follow the passage in order. A choice card can look back at a verse an earlier card in the same stop told, but never jumps ahead.
